comment: One provisioning bundle encoded by both codecs. The browser encoder in web-installer/provision.js must emit expectedHex for fields, and the production codec in lib/furble/protocol/ProvisionTLV.cpp must emit the same bytes for the same bundle. tests/web-installer/provision.test.cjs checks the browser side and tests/host/provision_tlv_test.cpp checks the firmware side, so a format change has to move this file.
